name: Spell Thief (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 14

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can steal magical effects from her foes. When she scores a critical hit against an opponent, as a free action she can try to siphon some of that target’s ongoing magical effects, as an arcana theft spell. Alternatively, she can do this when attacking a magic item, transferring the magical effects of the item to her own possessions as a siphon enhancement spell. Both of these effects use her saboteur level as her caster level and her saboteur trick DC in place of the spell’s normal save DC. She can do this once per day, plus an additional time per day at 17th and 20th levels.
